name: Boat ramp
summary: A launch lane's all-in cost is dominated by three pieces: the in-water concrete ramp (cofferdam/precast planks, 12-16 ft wide), the courtesy/boarding dock, and the trailer parking it needs (~30-35 car-trailer stalls per lane per Virginia DWR guidance). No public per-lane cost benchmark was found; the default is a bottom-up derived estimate bracketed by a recent single-lane state project (RI, $177k reconstruction) and 2026 Florida FBIP grant requests of ~$0.75-1.24M for ramp replacements. Low confidence — verify.

typicalSize.method: Public ramps are mostly 1-2 lanes (Olney Pond RI single lane, e1); regional facilities 3-6 lanes. Mid 2 is judgment.

parkingPerPrimaryUnit.method: Virginia DWR: 'one launching lane should have about 30-35 car-trailer parking spaces' (e2); low/high widen for low-use and high-demand sites.

primaryUnitsPerAcre.method: Per lane: 32 trailer stalls x 10 ft x 40 ft (e2) = 12,800 SF, plus aisles/turning (~2x) = ~26,000 SF, plus ramp approach/staging 30-40 ft radius and landscaping -> ~1 acre per lane.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Bottom-up per lane (estimating judgment, 2026 $): concrete ramp lane 16 ft x ~120 ft incl. cofferdam/precast planks and toe protection ~$150-300k; courtesy dock ~80-120 LF at ~$1,000-1,500/LF (cf. marina side-tie evidence) ~$100-150k; trailer parking ~26,000 SF of paving/drainage/lighting at ~$8-12/SF ~$200-300k (32 stalls, e2) -> ~$450-750k, mid $550k. Low bracket: Olney Pond RI single-lane reconstruction $176,557 in 2021 incl. docks and paved parking at an existing site (e1). High bracket: 2026 FBIP grant requests for full ramp replacements ($1.03M Branford, $1.19M Deep Creek Phase II, $1.24M Five Hole Springs, e3), and new ramps on undeveloped sites with access roads or channel dredging.

scope.notes: Per lane: ramp slab (cast-in-place above water, precast or cofferdam below), toe scour protection, one courtesy/boarding dock, approach/staging apron, trailer parking (~32 stalls), on-site drainage, lighting, signage. Excludes access road off-site, channel dredging, restrooms, breakwaters, land, permits/design.

qualityTiers.method: low/mid = 200k/550k = 0.36 (rounded 0.4; reuse of existing parking/approach); high/mid = 1.2M/550k = 2.2 for exposed coastal sites with breakwater-protected docks. Premium 1.5 = interpolated.

systemSplit.method: From the bottom-up per-lane build: ramp concrete (03) ~22%; courtesy dock/piles/toe protection (35) ~20%; trailer parking paving/curbs/striping (32) ~27%; earthwork, cofferdam/dewatering, erosion control (31) ~12%; drainage/stormwater (33) ~5%; lighting (26) ~4%; mobilization/general conditions (01) ~10%. Verify against a state bid tab.

lineItems.name: Courtesy / boarding dock (floating, ~100 LF per lane)

cost.method: Uses the lower half of marina floating side-tie dock evidence (~$1,000-1,400/LF incl. utilities, marina e13/e16); courtesy docks have no utilities, so mid $1,200/LF is judgment.

lineItems.name: Car-trailer parking stalls (10 ft x 40 ft)

cost.method: Trailer stall + aisle ~800 SF ~ 2.4x a car space (330 SF, parking-lot file); car-space cost $5-6.5k (parking-lot e1/e3) scaled by area x ~0.5 (paving is ~half of per-space cost) -> ~$8k per trailer stall. Qty 32 per lane (e2).

FBIP has funded stand-alone ramp restroom projects (e.g., 'St. Mary's Cove Boat Ramp Restroom' $36,214 grant, 'Steinhatchee Boat Ramp Restroom' $42,876 grant — partial funding, e3). Range is estimating judgment: precast vault toilet low; plumbed 2-stall building high.

lineItems.name: Approach channel dredging

cost.method: Same derived unit range as marina dredging line item (judgment). Virginia DWR advises at least 3 ft depth at the ramp toe at mean low water (e2).

lineItems.notes: Enter CY. FBIP 'Shell Mound Boat Ramp Channel Improvements' received $869,460 (e3) — channel work can rival the ramp cost.

cost.method: Included in the Olney Pond RI scope (e1) but not priced separately; manufactured floating launch + gangway range is judgment.

pctOfHard.method: Civil/coastal engineering, survey, geotech, USACE/state in-water permits and environmental review; in-water permitting pushes above a surface-lot's ~15% (judgment).

softCosts.notes: Texas TPWD boating-access grants fund up to 75% with a 25% local match and offer Phase I planning grants up to $250,000 (e4) — planning/permitting is a material share.

hard.method: Marine work norm, cf. Berkeley Marina 10% construction contingency (marina e10); judgment.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Low = RI single-lane reconstruction (~$177k in 2021, e1); high = $1.2M hard x 1.25 soft x 1.10 contingency = ~$1.65M for an exposed new site.

evidence.region: Lincoln, RI (Olney Pond, Lincoln Woods State Park)

source.title: Improvements to Boat Ramp at Olney Pond in Lincoln Woods to Get Underway in February
source.publisher: State of Rhode Island (DEM press release, 01-28-2021)

evidence.quote: single-lane concrete ramp ... 12-foot wide ... an adjacent row of floating docks ... $176,557
evidence.scopeNotes: Construction cost of a single-lane ramp reconstruction at an existing site incl. floating docks, T-dock, ADA kayak launch and paved parking with ADA spaces. 12 ft lane (vs. 16 ft preferred).

evidence.quote: one launching lane should have about 30-35 car-trailer parking spaces ... a vehicle-trailer parking space should be at least 10 feet wide and 40 feet long ... Ramps 16 feet wide are preferred for the general public.

source.title: 2026 FBIP Scores and Ranking (Florida Boating Improvement Program)
source.publisher: Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission

evidence.quote: Town of Branford ... Ivey Memorial Park Boat Ramp Replacement $ 1,032,900 ... DeSoto County ... Deep Creek- Boat Ramp Improvements Phase II $ 1,191,182 ... Hamilton County ... Five Hole Springs Boat Ramp Improvements $ 1,241,005 ... City of Panama City ... Downtown Marina Boat Ramp $ 750,000
evidence.scopeNotes: Grant amounts requested (not total project cost, lane counts not given); a lower bound on project cost for 1-2 lane replacements. Funded-projects page also lists FBIP grants such as 'St. Mary's Cove Boat Ramp Restroom' $36,214 and 'Shell Mound Boat Ramp Channel Improvements' $869,460 (https://myfwc.com/boating/grants-programs/fbip/funded-projects/).
Phase I planning grant cap; program covers 75% of costs with 25% local match. Context for soft costs only.

openQuestions: No sourced per-lane construction cost found — collect 3+ recent state wildlife agency or county bid tabs (lane count, dock LF, stall count).
FBIP grant amounts are not total project cost; obtain applications for the top-ranked ramp replacements to get totals and lane counts.
Search budget was exhausted during this research pass; a follow-up search for TPWD/ODFW/WDFW ramp contracts is recommended.
